capabilities: create a new note with a single tap on a floating button
open the newly created note immediately in editing mode
hide the button while a mobile sidebar is open
increment Untitled filenames to avoid overwriting existing files
extras: Deliberately limited scope: hidden on desktop and Android, no keyboard-aware repositioning, and the author explicitly avoids turning it into a general toolbar or command launcher. Requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or later.
motivation: The author wanted the Apple Notes-style always-accessible new-note button on iOS, which Obsidian Mobile does not currently provide in the main editor interface.
problem: Obsidian Mobile has no persistent, always-visible button for creating a new note from the main editor screen, unlike Apple Notes on iOS.
summary: Floating quick-create button, styled after Apple Notes, that makes a new note with one tap in Obsidian Mobile on iPhone and iPad.
